description: This file contains unit tests for the ImmutableLogicalFilter class in the org.eclipse.ditto.model.thingsearch package. It tests immutability, equality, string representation, and construction methods for logical filter objects.

classes.name: ImmutableLogicalFilterTest
classes.description: A final class containing unit tests for the ImmutableLogicalFilter class, verifying behavior such as immutability, equality, string output, and creation under different filter types.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that ImmutableLogicalFilter instances are immutable and that SearchFilter instances used within are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Tests the hashCode() and equals() methods of ImmutableLogicalFilter for correctness.

methods.name: tryToCreateNotFilterWithNullFilter
methods.description: Ensures that creating a NOT filter with null throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createNotFilter
methods.description: Creates a NOT filter and asserts its type and contained filter.

methods.name: toStringOfNotFilterReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the string representation of a NOT filter.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullFirstFilter
methods.description: Checks that passing null as the first filter in an AND filter throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullSecondFilter
methods.description: Checks that passing null as the second filter in an AND filter throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateAndFilterWithNullAdditionalFilters
methods.description: Checks that passing null among additional filters in an AND filter throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createAndFilter
methods.description: Creates an AND filter with multiple mock filters and verifies the filter's type and contained filters.

methods.name: toStringOfAndFilterReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the string representation of an AND filter.

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullFirstFilter
methods.description: Checks that passing null as the first filter in an OR filter throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullSecondFilter
methods.description: Checks that passing null as the second filter in an OR filter throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateOrFilterWithNullAdditionalFilters
methods.description: Checks that passing null among additional filters in an OR filter throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: createOrFilter
methods.description: Creates an OR filter with multiple mock filters and verifies its correctness.

methods.name: toStringOfOrFilterReturnsExpected
methods.description: Verifies the string representation of an OR filter.
